### Flood Fill

Type `floodFill`.

Finds the separate white regions of a mask (joined across the texture's edges) and stores each texel's region box, for the Fill To nodes. Feed those directly: they read it at its own resolution. Runs as its own pass.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | gray | input | `0` | Regions are where this is over 0.5. |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `passes` |  | `4` | GPU sweeps; more resolve winding regions. The CPU result is always exact. |

### Colorize

Type `colorize`.

Maps a gray value through a gradient: Low reads the gradient's left end, High its right. Each bound takes a value or a link, in the input's own units: -11000 and 8848 colour a height map stored in metres. The gradient's own setting picks linear, smooth or constant blending between stops.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | gray | input | `0.5` |  |
| `low` | float | input | `0` | The value that reads the gradient's left end. |
| `high` | float | input | `1` | The value that reads the gradient's right end. |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gradient` |  | `{'stops': [[0.0, [0, 0, 0, 1]], [1.0, [1, 1, 1, 1]]]}` |  |

## Generator

### AO Darken

Type `genAoDarken`.

A mask of the occluded areas from ambient occlusion, for darkening or tinting them.

### Cavity Grime

Type `genCavityGrime`.

Grime packed into crevices and tight corners (cavity, a little ambient occlusion), with fine grain.

### Dirt

Type `genDirt`.

Dirt gathering where the surface is occluded (ambient occlusion and cavities), broken up by a dirt noise.

### Drips

Type `genDrips`.

Streaks running down vertical surfaces (directional noise along v, masked to walls by the world normal).

### Dust

Type `genDust`.

Dust settling top-down on upward-facing surfaces, less where they are occluded, broken up by clouds.

### Edge Wear

Type `genEdgeWear`.

Wear on convex edges from curvature, broken up by noise.

### ID Select

Type `genIdSelect`.

White where the baked ID map is exactly the picked colour.

### Moss

Type `genMoss`.

Moss and growth on upward-facing surfaces, favouring sheltered (occluded) areas, in patches.

### Paint Chips

Type `genPaintChips`.

Hard-edged chips knocked out of paint, clustered on convex edges.

### Polygon Fill

Type `genPolygonFill`.

Fills whole UV islands or material/object/group IDs (the ID map's source) picked by colour, up to four.

### Position Gradient

Type `genPositionGradient`.

A gradient along an axis of the bake bounds (0 at start, 1 at end), optionally warped by noise.

### Rust Spread

Type `genRustSpread`.

Rust starting in crevices and on worn edges and spreading out through noise as spread rises.

### Scratches

Type `genScratches`.

Fine scratches, stronger on exposed surfaces (less where occluded).

### Sun Bleach

Type `genSunBleach`.

Fading on surfaces facing the sun, less where they are occluded.

### Thickness

Type `genThickness`.

A mask from the thickness map: thin parts (inverted) for subsurface, light bleed or wear.

### UV Island Random

Type `genUvIslandRandom`.

A random value per UV island (from the uvIslands map), for per-plank or per-panel variation.

### Wetness

Type `genWetness`.

Wet from a water line up (along an axis of the bake bounds) plus puddles on upward-facing surfaces.

### Fresnel

Type `fresnel`.

Brighter where the surface turns away from the viewer, from the mesh's world normal map. A texture has no camera of its own, so the view comes from View Direction, or per texel from Camera Position through the bake's position map. Pick a camera or take the active view in the panel to fill them.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `viewDirection` | vector | input | `[0, 0, -1]` | The way the camera looks, in world space. Used when View is direction. |
| `cameraPosition` | vector | input | `[0, 0, 500]` | Where the camera is, in world space (cm). Used when View is cameraPosition. |
| `boundsMin` | vector | input | `[0, 0, 0]` | The bake's position map spans boundsMin to boundsMax in world space. Picking a camera or taking the view fills both from the last bake; they follow live mesh maps while those run. |
| `boundsMax` | vector | input | `[1, 1, 1]` | The far corner of the position map's bounds. |
| `out` | gray | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `view` | `direction`, `cameraPosition` | `direction` | direction: one view direction everywhere, as an orthographic camera sees it. cameraPosition: from the camera to each texel's surface, as a perspective camera sees it; needs the position map. |
| `camera` | `camera` |  | The camera whose pose fills View Direction and Camera Position. Pick it again after moving it. |
| `model` | `schlick`, `power` | `schlick` | schlick: physical reflectance from the index of refraction. power: one minus the facing ratio, raised to Power. |
| `ior` |  | `1.5` | Index of refraction, for schlick: 1.33 water, 1.5 glass and plastic, 2.4 diamond. |
| `power` |  | `5` | For power: higher pulls the effect to the silhouette. |
| `bias` |  | `0` | Lifts the result where the surface faces the viewer. |

### Image

Type `image`.

An image file sampled in uv, wrapping at the edges, repeated tiles times. Relative paths resolve against the workspace, the scene's folder, then Lila's resources (strokes/strokes_soft.png names a shipped stroke sheet). The set samples the image at the set's resolution: when the image is larger, Match Set on the node raises the set to fit. 8 and 16-bit files read as 0..1; signed, 32-bit and float files (EXR, float or int16 TIFF) read as stored, so a height map keeps its units: map it with Colorize's Low and High. To show an image on an object without authoring maps, set it as a material's map in the Material Editor instead.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `coord` | vector | input |  | Where to read the image: the mesh's uvs unless linked (Projection, Mapping). |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |
| `alpha` | gray | output |  | The file's alpha; 1 where the file has none. |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` |  |  |  |
| `tiles` |  | `1` | Repeats across the texture. |
| `colorSpace` | `linear`, `srgb` | `linear` | How the file's colour values are read. linear: as stored, for data maps (roughness, normal, height) and EXR. srgb: decoded from sRGB to linear, for colour maps saved as 8 or 16-bit PNG, JPEG, TGA or TIFF. Alpha is never decoded. |

### Image Sequence

Type `imageSequence`.

Numbered image files played over the timeline, for animated textures. Pick any one frame: the last run of digits in its name is the frame number (or write # for each digit, as in fire_####.png), and every file in its folder numbered the same way joins the sequence in order. Sequence frame 0 is the first file on disk. Exports and bakes take the scene's current frame.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `coord` | vector | input |  | Where to read the frames: the mesh's uvs unless linked (Projection, Mapping). |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |
| `alpha` | gray | output |  | The frame's alpha; 1 where the files have none. |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `file` |  |  | Any frame of the sequence. |
| `start` |  | `1` | The scene frame the sequence's first frame shows on. |
| `offset` |  | `0` | Frames into the sequence at Start Frame. |
| `frames` |  | `0` | How many frames play before looping or holding; 0 plays every file found. |
| `speed` |  | `1` | Sequence frames per scene frame: 0.5 plays at half speed, negative plays backwards. Keyed, the speed accumulates over the frames from Start Frame, so a change of speed never jumps. |
| `loop` | `loop`, `hold`, `pingPong` | `loop` | loop: starts over. hold: stays on the end frame (the first one before Start Frame). pingPong: plays back and forth. |
| `interpolation` | `hold`, `blend` | `hold` | Between sequence frames, when Speed isn't a whole number. hold: shows the earlier frame. blend: crossfades into the next. |
| `tiles` |  | `1` | Repeats across the texture. |
| `colorSpace` | `linear`, `srgb` | `linear` | How the files' colour values are read. linear: as stored, for data maps and EXR. srgb: decoded from sRGB to linear, for colour frames saved as 8 or 16-bit PNG, JPEG, TGA or TIFF. Alpha is never decoded. |

| `position` | vector | output |  |  |

### Projection

Type `projection`.

Texture coordinates projected onto the mesh from the middle of its bake bounds instead of its uvs: flat, wrapped around a cylinder or around a sphere (an equirectangular map such as an earth texture). Link it into an Image's UV, through Mapping to move it.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `boundsMin` | vector | input | `[0, 0, 0]` | The bake's position map spans boundsMin to boundsMax, in cm. Adding the node fills both from the set's last bake, and they follow live mesh maps while those run, so the projection sits on the mesh's middle. |
| `boundsMax` | vector | input | `[1, 1, 1]` | The far corner of the position map's bounds. |
| `out` | vector | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shape` | `planar`, `cylindrical`, `spherical` | `planar` |  |
| `axis` | `x`, `y`, `z` | `y` | Planar: the direction it projects along. Cylindrical and spherical: the pole. |
| `size` |  | `100` | Planar and cylindrical: cm per repeat (height for cylindrical). |

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | color | input | `[0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1]` |  |
| `boundsMin` | vector | input | `[0, 0, 0]` | The bake's position map spans boundsMin to boundsMax. Adding the node fills both from the set's last bake, and they follow live mesh maps while those run, so the pattern keeps its proportions on a mesh that isn't a cube. |
| `boundsMax` | vector | input | `[1, 1, 1]` | The far corner of the position map's bounds. |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scale` |  | `1` | Repeats across the longest side of the bake's bounds. |
| `sharpness` |  | `4` |  |
| `rotation` |  | `180` | How far each axis's projection may turn, degrees. |
| `seed` |  | `0` |  |

| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `scale` |  | `1` | Repeats across the longest side of the bake's bounds. |
| `sharpness` |  | `4` | How quickly the projections hand over. |

### Layer Blend

Type `layerBlend`.

Composites a layer's channel over the stack below it: the blend mode result, mixed in by mask times opacity. addSigned adds around 0.5 (heights); saturation, color and value take that part from the layer, the rest from below.

| `below` | color | input | `[0, 0, 0, 1]` |  |
| `above` | color | input | `[1, 1, 1, 1]` |  |
| `mask` | gray | input | `1` |  |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `normal`, `add`, `subtract`, `multiply`, `screen`, `overlay`, `darken`, `lighten`, `difference`, `softLight`, `addSigned`, `colorBurn`, `linearBurn`, `colorDodge`, `hardLight`, `vividLight`, `linearLight`, `pinLight`, `exclusion`, `divide`, `saturation`, `color`, `value` | `normal` |  |
| `opacity` |  | `1` |  |

### Layer Decal

Type `layerDecal`.

Places one picture (or one cell of an atlas) on the mesh from a box in the mesh's object space, so it moves with the mesh: out is the picture there, mask its alpha inside the box and 0 outside. The bake's world-space position and normal maps are taken back to object space with the world matrix the mesh had when it baked.

| `objectX` | vector | input | `[1, 0, 0]` | The first column of the matrix from the bake's world space to the mesh's object space: the inverse of the world matrix the mesh had when it baked. The layer stack fills it and the next three from the set's bake, live mesh maps while those run. |

| `out` | color | output |  |  |
| `mask` | gray | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `planar`, `triplanar`, `spherical`, `cylindrical`, `warp` | `planar` | How the content lands on the mesh. |

## Layout

### Receive

Type `PortalReceive`.

Reads the value of the Send node with its name, without a wire. Takes that value's type.

### Reroute

A point a wire passes through, to steer it. Takes the type of whatever feeds it and can feed several inputs.

### Send

Type `PortalSend`.

Names the value wired into it, so Receive nodes anywhere in the graph can read it without a wire.

### Height Normal Rebuild

Type `heightNormalRebuild`.

The normal a material with Normals From Height shows (Unreal's MF_LilaHeightNormal): the height's own normals with the detail of the normal laid on them. Where the height is steep and the normal is well off it (a wall a bake missed), the height wins; elsewhere the normal comes through as it is. depth is the cm from height 0 to 1, sizeU and sizeV the world size of the UV square, fade the slope in degrees where the height takes over (0 keeps the normal).

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `normal` | color | input | `[0.5, 0.5, 1, 1]` |  |
| `height` | gray | input | `0.5` |  |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `depth` |  | `5` |  |
| `sizeU` |  | `100` |  |
| `sizeV` |  | `100` |  |
| `fade` |  | `45` |  |

Type `heightToNormal`.

A tangent-space normal (OpenGL, green up) from the slope of a height. depth is the cm from height 0 to 1 and sizeU, sizeV the world size of the UV square, cm, so the slopes are real ones; intensity scales them. Exports convert to the preset's convention.

### Pixel Processor

Type `pixelProcessor`.

Runs a Slang function body per texel: it sees uv, inputs a and b (colours) and c and d (grays) as a.sample(uv), the values x, y, z and w as p.x, and texel(), and returns a float4. Editing the code recompiles; the values don't.

| Socket | Type | Kind | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `a` | color | input | `[0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1]` |  |
| `b` | color | input | `[0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1]` |  |
| `c` | gray | input | `0.5` |  |
| `d` | gray | input | `0.5` |  |
| `out` | color | output |  |  |

| Property | Options | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `expression` |  | `float4 col = a.sample(uv);
return float4(col.rgb * p.x, col.a);` | Slang statements ending in a return of a float4. |
| `x` |  | `1` |  |
| `y` |  | `0` |  |
| `z` |  | `0` |  |
| `w` |  | `0` |  |

## TrimSheets extension

Available when the TrimSheets extension is loaded.

### Mesh

#### Trim Gradient

| `mirror` |  | `false` |  |
| `seed` |  | `0` |  |
